verdict.rationale: Bank and credit-card feeds are a fair axis for accounting software like Moneybird, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions connecting bank or card accounts or importing transactions daily. The payment items (iDEAL, credit card, direct debit) describe how customers pay invoices, which is an adjacent feature, not a bank feed.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect bank and credit-card accounts so transactions import automatically every day
